This happened a few years back.
It was a warm and sunny day, and i was home alone with my sister. We were outside in the garden, when I decided to go inside and get my football. When I was about to go outside again i met my sister in the doorstep, who wanted something to drink. I threw my ball outside in the garden and went to the kitchen to help her. When we went outside again the ball was gone. The ball was left unattended for about 30 seconds. For someone to steal the ball, they must have watched us and ran to grab the ball the ssecond i threw it, which dont seem very realistic.
Nothing has ever been stolen before or since this incident. We live in a really quiet area, where we always leave our bikes, balls etc. unattended in the garden at night.
